title: Candidate read request
description: PERD REQ-CTX-006 and REQ-AMB-002: POST /internal/v1/evidence/candidates, sent by the model service to core. Inputs are exactly {principal_ref, tenant_id, resource_kind, filters{amount_range?, time_window, counterparty_surface?}}. The query is scoped by principal at the repository layer, so a row the principal does not own is never a candidate. The time window is the TimeRef window already widened by the pack tolerance, and the amount range is exact or +-1% when the amount is uncertain (REQ-AMB-002); both are computed by the caller, not here. counterparty_surface is untrusted customer text (REQ-CTX-007): a bounded string, never an instruction. Its length cap (64) is an agent default raised as an open decision, not a SoT or PERD value.

resource_kind.description: <vertical>.<kind> of the resource to read, from the pack (for example fin.transaction).

time_window.description: Inclusive window on occurred_at; from must not be after to (checked by the reader).

AmountRange.description: Inclusive bounds in minor units; min_minor must not exceed max_minor (checked by the reader; JSON Schema cannot compare two fields).
